messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

- INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]

- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- On 2025-04-26, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour during INC-2025-011. [valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- As of 2025-11-20, dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-02-25 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-25]
- INC-2025-017 was caused by an expired intermediate certificate. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal observed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- On the 2025-12-15 rotation day, Tomasz Nowak handed the Team Dune pager to Farah. [valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-15]
- As of 2025-05-09, the reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-05-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-09]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the event bus is not Team Boreal's service. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-27]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline lives with Team Cinder; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]

Question: Who was responsible for reporting on 2025-11-26?

message.reasoning:
The question asks who was responsible for reporting on 2025-11-26.

Memory entries about reporting ownership:
- Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction] — supersedes the Team Boreal entry.

So for 2025-11-26, the valid entry is: reporting service moved to the Ember team. So the Ember team was responsible on 2025-11-26.

Note: "As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved... to the Ember team" — the move happened as of 2025-11-07 (per corrected entry), valid from 2025-11-17. On 2025-11-26, the reporting service is with the Ember team.

Also there's the pager handover: Tomasz Nowak handed the Team Dune pager to Farah on 2025-12-15 — that's after 2025-11-26 and about Team Dune's pager, not directly reporting responsibility.

Answer: the Ember team.
